method: Use stable id values and data-part attributes on meaningful groups or shapes; use data-person to distinguish people. Preserve painter order and keep detail geometry editable.
rules: Split skin regions where recolouring requires it.
Do not merge semantic regions into an uneditable flattened path.
Clothing-top and clothing-bottom apply only where these exist.
Do not infer gender or identity from region tags.
Review recoloured output for contrast and meaning.
Never convert a semantic role directly into a tactile texture without a design decision.
creation_requirement: Assign applicable semantic region tags when the SVG geometry is created; verification is a later check, not a tagging phase.
